title: First projection of an encoded pair
statement: For any two finite bit strings $a$ and $b$, the total first projection of their self-delimiting pair encoding is $a$.
replaced: Let $\langle a,b\rangle$ denote the self-delimiting pair encoding of bit strings $a$ and $b$ (every bit of $a$ doubled, then $01$, then $b$), and let $\pi_1$ be the total first projection, which returns the first component of a pair encoding and the empty word on any other bit string. Then $\pi_1(\langle a,b\rangle) = a$ for all bit strings $a, b$.
